title: 第20章 当面挖墙脚第21章 用心良苦
content_zh:
炼药宗师？
楚夏听到林岳的话，同样有些意外。
这颗龙血丹，的確是他耗费了一些心思炼成的下品灵丹。
丹药分凡品，灵品等等，林岳炼製的八品龙血丹，只是凡八品，楚夏炼製的哪怕只是一品灵丹，也远比凡品丹药强上百倍。
但只是炼製一枚灵丹，就有资格称之为炼药宗师嘛？
那宗师的含金量也未免太低了点吧。
毕竟楚夏昨天才开始接触炼丹。
这枚龙血丹只是他炼製的第二枚丹药而已啊。
“这位是本宫紫月殿的龙渊卫副將，名叫夏初，他是本宫培养多年的炼药师。”
夏紫萱走上前来说道。
她怕楚夏说漏嘴。
更怕楚夏被別人挖墙脚。
楚夏愣了愣，旋即明白了夏紫萱的想法。
他凑到夏紫萱耳边轻声道：“长公主，你有点护食了。”
夏紫萱俏脸微红，没好气的白了楚夏一眼。
这风情万种的一眼，谁看了不迷糊。
在场的文物官员们，感觉骨头都酥了。
长公主的容貌已然是冠绝天下，但之前从来都是一副冷若冰山的模样，令人高山仰止，难以直视。
可这一眼的风情，让人们忽然意识到，原来长公主也会露出这样的表情。
唯独林岳完全没注意到这一幕，他的目光从始至终都死死盯著楚夏。

“夏初前辈，请收我为徒！！”
林岳跪步上前，扑通一声重重拜倒在楚夏脚下，额头撞击地面发出一声闷响。
这突如其来的拜师，让在场眾人皆是一阵惊嘆。
林岳都八十多岁了，还是药王谷的首席炼药师，而夏初虽然戴著面具，可听声音最多也就三十来岁。
可林岳居然要拜夏初为师，这岂不是倒反天罡了。
楚夏也很意外。
但他很快就做出回应。
“我没有收徒的打算，你起来吧。”
“不，前辈今日若不收我为徒，我便在此长跪不起。”林岳说完，又砰砰砰的开始磕头。
给楚夏都整无语了。
不是，这老头年纪挺大，怎么还如此孩子气呢。
眼看著林岳额头都磕破了，鲜血染红了地面，楚夏还真怀疑，自己如果坚持不收徒，他是不是能把自己给活活磕死。
这老头属实有些生猛。
“行了，你快起来吧，我暂且收你当个记名弟子好了，但別指望我有多少时间教你，顶多閒暇时指点你两句。”
楚夏无奈说道。
要真让这老头磕死在他面前，那楚夏心里也过意不去。
再则，楚夏对药王谷多少有些了解，在大乾皇朝境內，药王谷是最大的民间炼药师势力，整个大乾境內的炼药师，大多都出自药王谷，无论在民间还是朝堂，药王谷都具有不俗的影响力。
据说在民间开办医馆，都需要由药王谷开具行医证明才行。
可以说相当有权势了。
而林岳作为药王谷的首席炼药师，显然也是颇具地位的。

收下这个老徒弟，对楚夏来说还是很划算的。
“多谢师尊！”
林岳老脸上的皱纹顿时舒展开来，又连忙磕了三个响头，这才晃晃悠悠的起身。
content_en:
Master of alchemy?
Chu Xia was also a little surprised when she heard Lin Yue's words.
This Dragon Blood Pill is indeed a low-grade elixir that he spent some effort to refine.
Pills are classified into mortal, spiritual, etc. The eighth-grade dragon blood pill refined by Lin Yue is only eighth-grade mortal. Even the first-grade spiritual pill refined by Chu Xia is hundreds of times stronger than the mortal pill.
But just by refining a magic pill, does he qualify to be called a master of alchemy?
Then the gold content of a grandmaster is a bit too low.
After all, Chu Xia just started getting into alchemy yesterday.
This Dragon Blood Pill is only the second pill he has refined.
"This is the deputy general of Longyuan Guard from Ziyue Palace of this palace. His name is Xia Chu. He is an alchemist that I have trained for many years."
Xia Zixuan stepped forward and said.
She was afraid that Chu Xia would spill the beans.
She was even more afraid that Chu Xia would be poached by others.
Chu Xia was stunned for a moment, and then understood Xia Zixuan's thoughts.
He leaned into Xia Zixuan's ear and whispered: "Eldest Princess, you are a bit protective of the food."
Xia Zixuan's pretty face turned red, and she rolled her eyes at Chu Xia angrily.
Who can look at this charming glance and not be confused.
The cultural relics officials present felt as if their bones were going numb.
The appearance of the eldest princess is already unparalleled in the world, but before, she had always looked as cold as an iceberg, making people look up at her and find it difficult to look directly at her.
But the charming look at this glance made people suddenly realize that the eldest princess would also show such an expression.
Only Lin Yue didn't notice this scene at all. His eyes were fixed on Chu Xia from beginning to end.
"Senior Xia Chu, please accept me as your disciple!!"
Lin Yue knelt forward, fell down at Chu Xia's feet with a plop, and made a muffled sound when his forehead hit the ground.
This sudden apprenticeship made everyone present marvel.
Lin Yuedu is over eighty years old and is still the chief alchemist of Yaowang Valley. Although Xia Chu is wearing a mask, his voice sounds like he is in his thirties at most.
But Lin Yue actually wanted to worship Xia Chu as his teacher. Wouldn't this be contrary to Tiangang?
Chu Xia was also surprised.
But he was quick to respond.
"I have no intention of taking on a disciple, so get up."
"No, if senior doesn't accept me as his disciple today, I won't be able to kneel here forever." After Lin Yue finished speaking, he started kowtowing again.
Chu Xia was speechless.
No, this old man is quite old, why is he still so childish?
Seeing Lin Yue's forehead bruised and the blood staining the ground red, Chu Xia really doubted whether he could beat himself to death if he insisted on not accepting a disciple.
This old man is really a bit fierce.
"Okay, get up quickly. I'll accept you as a registered disciple for now, but don't expect me to have much time to teach you. I can only give you a few pointers in my spare time."
Chu Xia said helplessly.
If the old man was really knocked to death in front of him, Chu Xia would feel very sorry.
Furthermore, Chu Xia knew something about Yaowang Valley. Yaowang Valley was the largest private alchemist force in the Daqian Dynasty. Most of the alchemists in the entire Daqian territory came from Yaowang Valley. Yaowang Valley had considerable influence both among the people and the court.
It is said that to open a private medical clinic, a medical certificate issued by Yaowanggu is required.
It can be said to be quite powerful.
As the chief alchemist of Yaowang Valley, Lin Yue obviously has a high status.
Taking on this old apprentice was a good deal for Chu Xia.
"Thank you Master!"
The wrinkles on Lin Yuelao's face suddenly relaxed, and he kowtowed three times before getting up unsteadily.
